function separatedImplementation(value: number): number;

function expectedImplementation(value: number): number;
function expectedImplementation(value: string): string;
function otherImplementation(value: number | string): number | string { return value; }
console.log(expectedImplementation(1));

function firstMissing(value: number): number;
function expectedGenericImplementation(value: string): string;
function otherGenericImplementation<T>(value: T): T { return value; }

  differentMethod(value: string): string { return value; }
